issues.description: Lecture constructor signature is inconsistent with the specification: the problem statement/UML requires a constructor initializing five attributes in this order (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors), but the template provides a three-parameter constructor (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents). This forces students to change the constructor signature beyond the provided stub and can cause confusion about the required parameters/order.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template constructor signature to `public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors)` to match the UML-required parameter count and order.
